tools.name: page
tools.description: Describe the current page in Oculo browser. Default: compact (~30-80 tokens). Use detail="a11y" for ref-tagged accessibility tree, detail="markdown" for full article content.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Perform an action in Oculo browser: click, navigate, scroll, press key, hover, type, login. Elements found by ref (from a11y snapshot), text, role, label, placeholder, or CSS selector.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Fill form fields in Oculo browser by label, placeholder, or data-placeholder text. Handles text, select, checkbox, textarea, and contenteditable (DraftJS, ProseMirror).

tools.name: read
tools.description: Extract structured data from the page in Oculo browser (search results, tables, lists, articles).

tools.name: run
tools.description: Execute a multi-step pipeline in Oculo browser. PREFERRED for any task with 2+ actions. Each step is an object with exactly ONE key: page, act, fill, read, wait, or if.

tools.name: media
tools.description: Generate images (Nano Banana / DALL-E 3) or videos (Veo 3.1) via Oculo browser.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Execute shell commands non-interactively via Oculo.

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: List all open browser tabs in Oculo.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Deep web research across multiple tabs via Oculo browser.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: Pre-fetch URL without navigating in Oculo browser.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate page or text to any language via Oculo browser.

tools.name: lens
tools.description: Visual analysis via screenshot in Oculo browser.
